entities.summary: Walisongo State Islamic University (UIN Walisongo) is a public university in Indonesia. It is also called Universitas Islam Negeri (UIN) Walisongo Semarang and located in Semarang, Central Java, Indonesia. Universitas Islam Negeri Walisongo is a university in Asia, established in 2014-10-17. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
